title: Food Packing Drive
description: Sort, pack and label food hampers for 300 low-income families in the Klang Valley.
location: Hope Food Bank Warehouse, Petaling Jaya

title: Beach Clean-up
description: Collect and sort marine debris along the coastline and learn about plastic pollution from marine biologists.

title: Reading Buddy Sessions
description: Read aloud and run simple literacy games with primary school children from underserved communities.
location: SK Sentul Community Library, Kuala Lumpur

title: Elderly Home Visit
description: Spend an afternoon with senior residents through games, music and light refreshments.
location: Golden Years Care Home, Subang Jaya

title: Urban Tree Planting
description: Plant 500 native saplings at a restored forest reserve. Gloves and tools are provided.

title: Animal Shelter Care
description: Help with feeding, cleaning kennels and walking rescued dogs at the shelter.

title: Digital Skills Workshop
description: Teach basic digital literacy and online safety to small business owners and senior citizens.

title: Community Kitchen Service
description: Prepare and serve hot meals to 150 homeless and low-income residents.
